The average daily traffic along EDSA has reached more than 427,000 vehicles, according to the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA).

In Jamie Santos’s Wednesday report on “24 Oras,” the volume of vehicles climbs 10% to 20% during the holiday season, which is equivalent to an additional 40,000 to 85,000 vehicles.
